given: the schema no longer carries the combined inventory_code and the split batch and serial fields are shown
when: an operator views the stock detail or list view
then: the combined tracking code is no longer displayed anywhere the split batch and serial fields now appear
architectural_notes: E2E: asserts the absence of the obsolete combined inventory_code across both SPA surfaces (detail + list, client/) after the schema split. Since inventory_code no longer exists in app/models Stock nor in the JSON returned by the boundary (app/routes/), the SPA view components must render only batch_number/serial_number and no combined-code field. Owner module is the SPA stock view components; the removal is verified end-to-end (UI + boundary JSON shape + real branch schema). No new cross-cutting concern.

independence.rationale: Distinct from AC1/AC2, which assert the split fields are present: this asserts the obsolete combined code is absent from the UI. Both surfaces could show batch and serial correctly while still also rendering the old combined code (fails this, passes AC1/AC2), or hide the combined code while failing to render the split fields (fails AC1/AC2, passes this), so it is separately breakable.
